setup_opentelemetry_tracing: setup OpenTelemetry tracing with an OTLP endpoint and service name for distributed tracing
create_uds_grpc_interceptor: create a UDSOpenTelemetryAioServerInterceptor instance to intercept gRPC calls over Unix domain sockets
start_tracing_span: start a tracing span with gRPC method attributes and Unix transport for a handler call
configure_span_exporter: configure an OTLPSpanExporter with BatchSpanProcessor to export spans to an OTLP endpoint
review_tracing_setup: review the setup_tracing function and UDSOpenTelemetryAioServerInterceptor class for OpenTelemetry gRPC tracing configuration
